name: brutalism
label: Brutalism
css: .style-brutalism { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 3px solid var(--slide-primary, #DD614C); font-family: 'Darker Grotesque', sans-serif; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 48px; min-height: 1080px; width: 1080px; box-sizing: border-box; } .style-brutalism .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); letter-spacing: -2px; margin: 0; max-width: 90%; word-break: break-word; } .style-brutalism .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; word-break: break-word; } .style-brutalism .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; margin: 0; } .style-brutalism .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 48px; left: 48px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Darker Grotesque', sans-serif; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin: 0; } .style-brutalism::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; border: 3px solid var(--slide-primary, #DD614C); pointer-events: none; } .slide-code.style-brutalism { background-color: #1a1a1a; border-color: var(--slide-primary, #DD614C); color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-brutalism .hook, .slide-code.style-brutalism .text, .slide-code.style-brutalism .brand, .slide-code.style-brutalism .step { color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-brutalism .step { color: #e0e0e0; opacity: 0.18; } .slide-insight.style-brutalism { background-color: #111827; border-color: var(--slide-primary, #DD614C); } .slide-insight.style-brutalism .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #DD614C); } .slide-insight.style-brutalism .text { color: #f3f4f6; } .slide-insight.style-brutalism .brand { color: #f3f4f6; } .slide-insight.style-brutalism .step { color: #f3f4f6; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-brutalism .insight-text { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.3; margin: 24px 0; max-width: 90%; }
